text:
Name: Dickcissel - Family Fringillidae (partial)
Montana resident in: Summer.
Habitat: Roadsides, fields, meadows, other open areas. Nests in low bush.
Foods: 50 % animal matter. Insects, bristlegrass, oats, wheat, corn.
Name: Finches - Family Fringillidae (partial)
Montana resident in: Summer, winter, migratory only.
Habitat: Mountains and woodlands except for House finch which may inhabit towns, ranches, open woods, canyons, and deserts.
Foods: Near 100 % plant foods - buds, fruits, seeds. Elm, ragweed, aspen, poison ivy, mullein, mustard, pigweed, chickweed, sedge, oats, wheat, aphids, caterpillars and others.
Miscellaneous: Includes: purple, house, gray-crowned resy, black rosy finches, and pine siskin.
Name: Gold finches - Family Fringillidae (partial)
Montana resident in: Summer.
Habitat: Rivergroves, willows, orchards, roadsides. Nest is a felt cup in a tree.
Foods: Near 100% plant except spring. Aphids, caterpillars, ragweed, thistle, shepards-purse, goosefoot, sunflower, dandelion, golden, chuckweed, evening primrose, cane flower, pine, elm.
Miscellaneous: Includes: American (common) gold finch.
Name: Crossbills - Family Fringillidae (partial)
Montana resident in; Summer, winter.
Habitat: Conifer forests, and groves. Nest is a flat cup in a conifer.
Foods: Near 100% plants except in summer months. Spiders, insects, pine (66%) ragweed, other conifers.
Miscellaneous: Includes: Red Crossbill.
Name: Towhees - Family Fringillidae (partial)
Montana resident in: Summer.
Habitat: Dry mountain brush, chaparcal, sage, open pines, city shrubs.

Nests are on the ground or lowing bush.
Foods: Spiders, insects, pigweed, dandelion, ricegrass, corn, sedge, strawberry, chickweed.
Micellaneous: Includes: Green-tailed and rufous-sided towhees.
Name: Lark Bunting - Family Fringillidae (partial)
Montana resident in: Summer.
Habitat: Plains and praries. Nest on ground.
Foods: Mostly animal. Grasshoppers (50%+), beetles and weevils (2nd), other insects, needlegrass, pigweed, oats, dropseed, gromwell, goosefoot.
Name: Sparrows - Family Fringillidae (partial)
Montana resident in: Summer, winter, migratory only.
Habitat: Large group; may be present in most habitat types.
